evidence: Resident Orientals, Regulation and Promotion of Pacific Shipping, Modern Turkey, Greece Today, Levantine Concession Hunting and Humboldt Current in 1941 are Eliot Grinnell Mears's works (11/12 weighted citations). Clinical Trials of Oral Contraceptives is by Eleanor Mears.

Saints, Seaways and Settlements, Britain and the Western Seaways, Le Pays de Galles and The Settlements of the Celtic Saints are Emrys George Bowen's (9/12 weighted citations). Radar Days is by radar scientist Edward George Bowen; Roman Currency under the Republic is by Edwin W. Bowen.

The museum books and Mackenzie Basin archaeology, including Preserving Diversity, are Robert R. Janes's (11/13 weighted citations). Henry Fielding Reinvents the Afterlife and On the Reception of Mary Wollstonecraft's A Vindication of the Rights of Woman are by Regina M. Janes.

Rose's novels, essays and Pleasure of Ruins account for 7/11 weighted citations, a borderline roughly two-thirds share. Both Bombay Burmah history entries are R. H. Macaulay's; the dialect article is Ronald K. S. Macaulay's. The Bassett photograph fragment likely represents R. H. H. Macaulay's Trading into Hudson's Bay.

The Cassius Dio, Strabo, imperial cult and Roman Rule titles are Jesper Majbom Madsen's contributions or edited volumes (8/11 weighted citations). Trade Barriers and the Collapse of World Trade is by Jakob B. Madsen (2); the epileptic-seizure report includes physician Joseph Madsen (1).

Winnie-the-Pooh, The House at Pooh Corner and It's Too Late Now are Alan Alexander's (4 weighted citations). Sir Alfred Lewis Jones is Alan Hay Milne's (3); The Social Philosophy of English Idealism is A. J. M. Milne's (2); Tick Fever includes A. D. Milne (1). A University Career remains unconfirmed; the LC share is about 36-45%.

LC n94009842 identifies James Benson Sellers, author of Slavery in Alabama and The Prohibition Movement in Alabama (3/11 weighted citations). The Economic Incidence of the Civil War, Before We Were Members and James R. Doolittle belong to James L. Sellers; The South and Christian Ethics is by the Vanderbilt ethicist James Sellers.

The Huguenot Struggle, Massacre of St Bartholomew, French Secretaries of State, Princes, Politics and Religion, Lorraine article and Henry IV book are Nicola Mary Sutherland's (15/16 weighted citations). Don't Worry, Mr. Trimble is coauthored by Alaeric Sutherland, whom the publisher names explicitly.

The Sport of the Gods, Candle-Lightin' Time, poetry, stories and contemporary essays are the poet Paul Laurence Dunbar's (16/19 weighted citations). Hidden in Plain Sight (3) is by Paul Lawrence Dunbar, a contemporary author identified with a Denton, Texas address and university email on the publisher's page.

Lendo o Passado, Mycenaean Greece, The Ancient Spartans and the Webster commemorative volume involve classicist J. T. Hooker (4/10 weighted citations). Henry Sylvester Williams and Shortages Among the Surplus are J. R. Hooker's; Needed: An Empirical Science of Algorithms is J. N. Hooker's. The flora, Himalayan journals and Botanical Magazine belong to the botanical Hooker corpus.
